The old context-file ENSREG URL .../nuclear-safety-regulation/eu-instruments/Nuclear-Safety-Directive now returns 404 (appended to the new host). Verified: PDF resolves (200, application/pdf, 1.1 MB, 58 pages; the www.wenra.eu host redirects to wenra.eu). Content: Issues A-TU (A Safety Policy ... TU External Hazards), 'Report 17th February 2021'. Landing page wenra.eu/node/86 'WENRA Safety Reference Levels for Existing Reactors Revision 2020'. To upgrade to full_text, ask the WENRA Technical Secretariat (hosted by GRS) for written permission; ONR TAGs and UK/EU regulators often quote these SRLs, so metadata plus short attributed snippets may still serve users.
